description: Work with Klaviyo profiles, events, campaigns, flows, segments, templates, and local performance analytics for marketing automation.

novel_features.name: Campaign Deploy
novel_features.description: Create an email template, create a draft campaign, and assign the template to the campaign message in one audited workflow.

novel_features.name: Campaign Image Swap
novel_features.description: Find a campaign message template and replace an image URL inside the HTML while preserving the rest of the draft.

novel_features.name: Campaign A/B Test
novel_features.description: Add subject-line variations to one unscheduled draft email message, configure winner selection, and verify the saved test.

novel_features.name: Campaign A/B Results
novel_features.description: Compare per-variation email rates with two-proportion z-tests and infer Klaviyo's rollout winner from recipient counts.

novel_features.name: Flow Decay
novel_features.description: Identify flows whose open or click performance has decayed across recent time buckets using synced local data.

novel_features.name: Cohort Retention
novel_features.description: Group profiles by first event date and compute retention or repeat-action curves from synced profiles and events.

novel_features.name: Attribution Join
novel_features.description: Join order events with campaign and flow attribution properties to summarize revenue by channel and source.

novel_features.name: Profile Dedup
novel_features.description: Find profiles that appear duplicated by email, phone, or cross-channel collisions in the local profile mirror.

novel_features.name: Campaign Reconcile
novel_features.description: Compare campaign UTM evidence with local Klaviyo order events and optional Shopify credentials when available.

novel_features.name: Brief To Strategy
novel_features.description: Turn a growth brief into a structured Klaviyo campaign, flow, segment, and experiment strategy.

novel_features.name: QA Gate
novel_features.description: Run a launch-readiness checklist for links, offers, dates, timezone, fallback tokens, compliance and deliverability; with --brand, also check colors, logos and the footer against the Klaviyo brand kit.

novel_features.name: Targeting Report
novel_features.description: Join campaign audience segments to sends, attributed revenue, exclusions, last-mailed dates, and a never-mailed segment list.

novel_features.name: Send Budget
novel_features.description: Show this billing period's email sends against the plan cap, add recipient estimates for every scheduled campaign, and say whether the period goes over and by how much.

novel_features.name: Flow Insert Step
novel_features.description: Preview a flow before and after adding one step after an existing action, then insert it with --apply and confirm the placement from a re-read.

novel_features.name: Form Publish
novel_features.description: Show the draft-versus-live changes and the last 30 days of views and submits for a signup form, then publish the draft with --apply.

novel_features.name: Form Unpublish
novel_features.description: Show a live form's last 30 days of numbers, then take it down with --apply and confirm it is no longer live.

novel_features.name: Campaign Test Send
novel_features.description: Run the campaign QA gate and, only when it passes, email a preview of each email variation to up to five team addresses.
